listings_country_postal_idx.name: listings_country_postal_idx
listings_country_postal_idx.where: status = 'active' AND postal_code IS NOT NULL

listings_organization_ranked_idx.name: listings_organization_ranked_idx
listings_organization_ranked_idx.where: status = 'active' AND organization_id IS NOT NULL

listings_publishable_check.name: listings_publishable_check
listings_publishable_check.value:
"listings"."status" IN ('draft', 'deleted') OR (
        "listings"."category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."location_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "listings"."point" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."location_precision" IS NOT NULL
        AND char_length("listings"."title") >= 3)

listings_price_required_check.name: listings_price_required_check
listings_price_required_check.value: "listings"."status" IN ('draft', 'deleted') OR ("listings"."price_type" IN ('fixed', 'negotiable')) = ("listings"."price_minor" IS NOT NULL)

generated.as:
CASE WHEN phash IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ARRAY[
          ((phash >> 48) & 65535)::int,
          ((phash >> 32) & 65535)::int + 65536,
          ((phash >> 16) & 65535)::int + 131072,
          ( phash        & 65535)::int + 196608 ]
        END

phone_verifications_sms_check.name: phone_verifications_sms_check
phone_verifications_sms_check.value: "phone_verifications"."method" <> 'sms' OR ("phone_verifications"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL AND "phone_verifications"."code_hash" IS NOT NULL)

phone_verifications_verified_check.name: phone_verifications_verified_check
phone_verifications_verified_check.value: "phone_verifications"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("phone_verifications"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "phone_verifications"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL)

organization_invitations_pending_idx.name: organization_invitations_pending_idx
organization_invitations_pending_idx.where: accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

moderation_decisions_statement_check.name: moderation_decisions_statement_check
moderation_decisions_statement_check.value:
"moderation_decisions"."decision" NOT IN ('reject', 'remove', 'hide', 'warn', 'sanction') OR (
        "moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_decisions"."statement_fa" IS NOT NULL
        AND num_nonnulls("moderation_decisions"."policy_ground", "moderation_decisions"."legal_ground") >= 1)

reports_open_per_reporter_listing_key.name: reports_open_per_reporter_listing_key
reports_open_per_reporter_listing_key.where: status IN ('open', 'in_review') AND reporter_user_id IS NOT NULL AND listing_id IS NOT NULL

reports_open_per_reporter_message_key.name: reports_open_per_reporter_message_key
reports_open_per_reporter_message_key.where: status IN ('open', 'in_review') AND reporter_user_id IS NOT NULL AND message_id IS NOT NULL

entitlements_listing_idx.name: entitlements_listing_idx
entitlements_listing_idx.where: listing_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

entitlements_paid_slots_idx.name: entitlements_paid_slots_idx
entitlements_paid_slots_idx.where: type IN ('featured', 'top_of_category', 'homepage') AND revoked_at IS NULL

entitlements_organization_idx.name: entitlements_organization_idx
entitlements_organization_idx.where: organization_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

entitlements_user_idx.name: entitlements_user_idx
entitlements_user_idx.where: user_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

entitlements_due_bumps_idx.name: entitlements_due_bumps_idx
entitlements_due_bumps_idx.where: type = 'bump' AND applied_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
